question: Who is the author of the book 'Slumdog Millionaire'?
solution:
Correct Answer **Vikas Swarup**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vikas Swarup **is an** Indian author and diplomat.**
 
• He was born on **August 10, 1963, in Allahabad, India.**
 
• **Swarup** is best known for his debut novel** "Q&A,"** which was later adapted into the **Academy Award-winning film** **"Slumdog Millionaire.**
 
• Vikas Swarup is the author of "**Six Suspects" and "The Accidental Apprentice"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** Dr APJ. Abdul Kalam was the 11th President of India.

 
• He served as the president of India from 2002 to 2007.
 
• He was the first scientist to become the president of India.
 
• He is well known as the "missile man of India".
 
• He was honored with the Bharat Ratna award in 1997.
 
• He died on 27th July 2015​
 
• "Wings of Fire" is the autobiography of Dr. APJ. Abdul Kalam
 
• Notable works are:
 
 
• The luminous spark.
 
• India 2020.
 
• Mission India
 
• Ignited Minds.
 
• Indomitable Spirit.
 
• Inspiring Thoughts.
 
 

K. R. Narayanan :

 
• Kocheril Raman Narayanan was an Indian diplomat, academic, and politician.

 
 
• who served as the 10th President of India and the 9th Vice President of India.
 
 
 
• Books:
 
 
• Images and insights, Nehru and his vision, President Speaks: Three Speeches of President K R Narayanan in the 21st Century India, In the Name of the People: Reflections on Democracy, Freedom, and Development
